title: Lilycle Rainbow Stage!!!
description:
Lilycle is a fun, adorable, and relaxing game about six yuri couples (plus one main love triangle!) interacting and strengthening their feelings for each other. You mainly follow Yuno, Tamaki, and Saeka as they navigate their budding romance and pursue their other girls, admiring the precious moments between them and six other couples from the perspective of each cute girl.

Every girl and every couple is unique in both character and dynamic, offering a wide variety of sweet and tender moments to enjoy.

Experience scenes from the point of view of each one of the 15 girls featured in this game, giving every one of them a chance to shine.

You can enjoy the talents of a full cast of talented voice actresses such as Juri Kimura (Shirobako), MAO (Flip Flappers, Keijo), Haruka Terui (Yuki Yuna is a Hero), Shiori Mikami (Attack on Titan, Yuru Yuri), Azumi Asakura (iDOLM@STER, High School DxD), Maaya Uchida (iDOLM@STER, Love Chunibyou & Other Delusions), Aya Uchida (Love Live!, Danganronpa 2, Kemono Friends), Rumi Okubo (Fate/Apocrypha, Yuru Yuri), Aya Suzaki (Kill la Kill, Tamako Market), and more in this cute, slice-of-life about girls enjoying girls! 

Playing through and viewing the chapters of these girls' stories through the calendar will steadily unlock new scenes to enjoy, sometimes from prior days too. Can you unlock each and every one of them?

 

Enjoy many detailed scenes and characters illustrated by Miwabe Sakura, illustrator for the light novel, "I'm Giving the Disgraced Noble Lady I Rescued a Crash Course in Naughtiness."
description_short: In this yuri visual novel featuring an all-star cast, you follow one main love triangle as they navigate their budding romance and the pursuit of their goals, unlocking new, heartwarming events to view from the perspectives of each cute girl in six other precious couples as well.
